title: Microsoft Purview: legacy Teams retention policies will stop covering Copilot interactions
summary: The briefing accurately describes the planned loss of Copilot coverage, the rollout dates, and the need for an explicit Copilot retention policy. Minor corrections should flag conflicting Microsoft command guidance, complete the portal route, name the applicable licences, and align the checklist and impact rating with the standard.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Administrators relying on Teams retention policies for Copilot must configure retention explicitly for Copilot.
claims.quote: Action is required if you currently rely on Teams retention policies to govern Copilot interactions. Configure retention policies explicitly for the Copilot workload to maintain the desired compliance coverage after this change.

claims.where: Scope: Who is affected; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The affected audience is organisations relying on historical Teams policies for Copilot and their compliance and records management administrators.
claims.quote: Organizations using Microsoft Purview retention policies that were historically configured for Microsoft Teams and currently rely on those policies to retain or delete Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions

claims.claim: MC1481313 recommends updating internal compliance guidance and informing compliance and records management stakeholders.
claims.quote: Update internal compliance documentation and administrator guidance as needed.- Inform compliance and records management stakeholders of this change.

claims.claim: Learn gives 15 January 2027 as the beginning of the legacy policy change.
claims.quote: Beginning 15th January, 2027, Microsoft Purview will treat 'Teams chats and Copilot interactions" policy as Teams-only policies.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The affected legacy location is named Teams chats and Copilot interactions.
claims.quote: Previously, retention policies used the location Teams chats and Copilot interactions that combined Teams chat and Copilot interactions.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Get still shows MicrosoftTeams rather than TeamsChatUserInteractions for converted legacy combined policies.
claims.quote: doing a Get command on 'Teams chats and Copilot interactions' policies from cmdlet will still show the policy covering teams+copilot i.e. MicrosoftTeams and NOT TeamsChatUserInteractions but while processing; they will ONLY cover Teams Interactions.

claims.claim: Learn recommends the Compliance Administrator role group for managing retention policies.
claims.quote: To grant permissions for this limited administration, we recommend that you add users to the Compliance Administrator admin role group.

claims.claim: A custom role group with Retention Management is an alternative.
claims.quote: Alternatively to using this default role, you can create a new role group and add the Retention Management role to this group.

claims.claim: View-Only Retention Management provides read-only retention permissions.
claims.quote: For a read-only role, use View-Only Retention Management.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls: Roles
claims.claim: Creating and managing replacement retention policies requires permissions to the Purview portal.
claims.quote: Members of your compliance team who will create and manage retention policies and retention labels need permissions to the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.claim: The retention policy inventory is at Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies.

claims.claim: Get-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -DistributionDetail | Format-List retrieves policy details in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote:
Get-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Identity "Regulation 123 Compliance" -DistributionDetail | Format-List
This example displays detailed information for the policy named "Regulation 123 Compliance", including accurate values for the DistributionStatus and *Location properties.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy is the portal route given for configuring Copilot retention.
claims.quote: Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration, and name your new retention policy.
claims.fix: Complete this early-ending route with a documented static-policy example: 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy > Microsoft Copilot experiences > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both'. Keep the current docs URL.

claims.claim: Set-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -Applications "User:M365Copilot" adds Copilot to an existing newer-location policy in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote:
To add Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions to an existing retention policy for newer locations, such as Teams private channel messages and Viva Engage:
Set-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy -Identity “<policy name>” -Applications "User:M365Copilot"
claims.fix: Append to controls[1].note: 'The configuration guide shows User:M365Copilot alone, but the cmdlet reference marks Microsoft Copilot experiences as preview and requires all these values together: User:M365Copilot,CopilotForSecurity,CopilotinFabricPowerBI,CopilotStudio,CopilotinBusinessApplicationplatformsSales,SQLCopilot. Confirm the supported syntax before running this example.' Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/set-appretentioncompliancepolicy#-applications to sources. The cited guide supports the printed call; this is a disagreement between Microsoft pages.

claims.claim: Selecting the Microsoft Copilot experiences location configures retention coverage for Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions.
claims.quote: Create a new retention policy explicitly configured for Copilot by selecting "Microsoft Copilot Experiences" location to maintain the required retention coverage for Copilot interactions.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions are not charged under the documented Purview billing model.
claims.quote: There's no charge for Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions.

claims.claim: The Data Lifecycle Management meter counts non-Microsoft 365 Copilot or AI app prompts and responses under a retention policy.
claims.quote: Number of non-Microsoft 365 Copilot or AI App interactions (prompts and responses) under a retention policy

claims.claim: The get-started page refers readers to the Purview service description for feature-level licensing requirements.
claims.quote: For the features listed on this page, see the Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management & Records Management section for feature-level licensing requirements.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, with licence requirements and required pay-as-you-go setup.
claims.quote: The pay-as-you-go billing model builds on the per-user licensing model. The two are complementary, not mutually exclusive.
claims.fix: Keep mixed, but name the entitlement in licensing.notes: 'The Purview service description lists Microsoft 365 E3/E5 + Microsoft 365 Copilot; Microsoft 365 E3 + Microsoft Purview Suite + Microsoft 365 Copilot; or Microsoft 365 E3 + Microsoft E5 Information Protection and Governance + Microsoft 365 Copilot as providing user rights for Copilot interaction retention. Pay-as-you-go setup is required, but Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions are not charged.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not explain the conversion-specific release or deletion eligibility of Copilot items already held by legacy policies.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams chats and Copilot interactions" "previously retained" "released" January 2027; read create-retention-policies, retention-policies-copilot and MC1481313. They state loss of coverage, but do not specify conversion-specific release or deletion processing for held items.

claims.claim: A reliable conversion-specific identification method for legacy combined policies remains undocumented beyond the stated Get-output caveat.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams chats and Copilot interactions" identify legacy policies portal PowerShell conversion notification tenant January 2027; read create-retention-policies, Get-RetentionCompliancePolicy and retention-cmdlets excerpts. No further conversion-specific identification procedure was found.

claims.claim: Whether tenants receive notification when their own conversion completes remains an open question.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams chats and Copilot interactions" identify legacy policies portal PowerShell conversion notification tenant January 2027; read MC1481313 and create-retention-policies. Neither states that individual tenants receive a completion notice.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No additional cost specific to the conversion is stated beyond administrator work.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Copilot retention policies license requirements Microsoft 365 Copilot pay as you go no charge; read the service description, billing models, get-started page and MC1481313. Existing licence rights are stated; no conversion-specific charge was found.

claims.claim: The billing setup instruction in the governance checklist has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Set up pay-as-you-go billing if it is not in place'. The two controls rows cover policy inventory and Copilot retention configuration, not billing setup.
claims.fix: Replace that checklist bullet with 'Pay-as-you-go billing is a prerequisite for creating policies that include the Microsoft Copilot experiences location; see Cost and licensing.' Do not add a control row.

claims.claim: Medium impact is justified by compliance and records management administrators being the people who notice first.
claims.quote: Rationale: 'Compliance and records management administrators who rely on Teams policies for Copilot data notice first'. Scale: 'low: admins only, or a small opt-in group'. The body describes this as not user-visible.
claims.fix: Set impact to low and replace the impact rationale with 'Low. Compliance and records management administrators must maintain Copilot retention coverage; Teams retention behaviour remains unchanged.'
